name: create_contact
description: Save a new contact. Copy the name word for word and the number digit for digit; never invent or complete them.

name.description: Full name of the contact, copied word for word.

phone.description: The phone number exactly as given; include only when stated.

email.description: The email address; include only when stated.

name: log_expense
description: Record money spent. Log only amounts the user stated; never estimate.

amount.description: The amount as stated, digits only.

category.description: The spending category the user named.

merchant.description: The store or vendor copied word for word; include only when named.

name: log_meal
description: Log a meal or food item. Use log_expense for money spent on food.

description.description: What was eaten, copied word for word.

meal_type.description: Which meal; include only when stated.

name: log_water_intake
description: Log water consumption in your water log.

name: log_weight
description: Record a body-weight measurement in kilograms.

weight_kg.description: The weight in kilograms as stated.
